page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 8 vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, supported by a 33 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance consistently in the average tier across most compute and memory workloads. The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16. In synthetic testing, the instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1325.0 and a multi-core score of 5125.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 9694.64. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 462.63 GB/sec and a large block uncached write speed of 40.88 GB/sec. However, database performance is mixed; while PassMark database operations scored 3175.46, Redis SET operations performed in the bottom 25% tier at 8.0 million operations per second.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7ne.2xlarge offers a balanced resource profile for general-purpose workloads that do not require high-speed local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable performance for multi-threaded tasks such as software compilation, which scored 7735.0 on Geekbench, and static web serving, which reached a throughput of 7.87 GB/sec. This instance is well-suited for application servers, web serving, software development environments, and moderate computational tasks that benefit from AVX-512 vector extensions.
